result:
Admins can now change a user's role from a select in each row of the users table. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **API:** `features/users/api/update-user-role.ts` sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`. On success it invalidates the `['users']` query, so the list shows the new role. It also shows a "User Role Updated" success notification.
- **UI:** `features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx` is an ADMIN/USER select. `users-list.tsx` uses it in the Role column. The select is disabled for your own row and while a change is saving.
- **Mock API:** `testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts` has a matching handler that requires an admin and only updates users in the same team.

The notification is in the hook rather than the component. A `no-restricted-imports` rule blocks `useNotifications` in feature components. That means this notification differs from the existing `delete-user.tsx` and `update-profile.tsx`, which still import it in the component.

The lint hook reported an error on `update-user-role.tsx` after my first edit. A search of the users feature confirms the import is no longer in that file, so the error should be gone, but I haven't re-run lint to check.
